```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = "asis")
source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
report_start("read_annotate")

ra <- function(...) p("results", "read_annotate", ...)
n_libraries <- length(libraries())
tool_ran <- character(0)

# Stacked bars of relative abundance per library
composition_plot <- function(table, value = "share", fill = "taxon", x_label = "Relative abundance (%)") {
  levels_taxa <- c(setdiff(names(sort(tapply(table[[value]], table[[fill]], sum), decreasing = TRUE)), "Other"), "Other")
  levels_taxa <- levels_taxa[levels_taxa %in% table[[fill]]]
  table[[fill]] <- factor(table[[fill]], levels = rev(levels_taxa))
  table$library <- factor(table$library, levels = rev(unique(libraries())))
  ggplot(table, aes(.data[[value]], library, fill = .data[[fill]])) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = category_colours(levels_taxa), name = NULL, guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE, ncol = 3)) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = NULL) +
    theme_report() +
    library_axis(n_distinct(table$library))
}

heatmap_plot <- function(table, x = "library", y = "feature", value = "value", legend = "log10(value + 1)") {
  table[[y]] <- factor(table[[y]], levels = rev(unique(table[[y]])))
  table[[x]] <- factor(table[[x]], levels = unique(table[[x]]))
  ggplot(table, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]], fill = .data[[value]])) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = legend) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_report() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1))
}

shannon <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x > 0]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  share <- x / sum(x)
  -sum(share * log(share))
}

# ---- Kraken2 ----
kraken_dbs <- names(ctx$features$databases$kraken2)
kraken <- map_dfr(kraken_dbs, function(db) {
  map_dfr(libraries(), function(library) {
    file <- ra("kraken2", db, paste0(library, ".report"))
    if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
    read.delim(file, header = FALSE, quote = "", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
               col.names = c("pct", "clade", "direct", "rank", "taxid", "name")) %>%
      mutate(name = trimws(name), database = db, library = library)
  })
})
kraken_summary <- if (nrow(kraken) > 0) {
  kraken %>%
    group_by(database, library) %>%
    summarise(
      total = sum(direct),
      unclassified = sum(direct[name == "unclassified"]),
      classified = total - unclassified,
      classified_pct = 100 * classified / total,
      species = sum(rank == "S" & clade > 0),
      genera = sum(rank == "G" & clade > 0),
      shannon_species = shannon(clade[rank == "S"]),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
} else {
  tibble()
}

# ---- Nonpareil ----
nonpareil_file <- ra("nonpareil", "nonpareil.tsv")
nonpareil <- if (file.exists(nonpareil_file)) read_table_quiet(nonpareil_file) else tibble()

# ---- NCyc ----
read_ncyc <- function(file) {
  lines <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
  sampling <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^#random sampling: ", "", grep("^#random sampling", lines, value = TRUE)[1])))
  list(sampling = sampling, table = read_tsv(I(paste(lines[!grepl("^#", lines)], collapse = "\n")), show_col_types = FALSE))
}
ncyc_file <- ra("ncyc", "ncyc_results.tsv")
ncyc <- if (file.exists(ncyc_file)) read_ncyc(ncyc_file) else NULL

# ---- MetaPhlAn ----
metaphlan_file <- ra("metaphlan", "metaphlan_profiled.tsv")
read_metaphlan <- function(file) {
  lines <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
  header <- grep("clade_name|^ID\t|^#SampleID", lines)[1]
  if (is.na(header)) header <- 1
  table <- read_tsv(I(paste(sub("^#", "", lines[header:length(lines)]), collapse = "\n")), show_col_types = FALSE)
  names(table)[1] <- "clade"
  table
}
metaphlan <- if (file.exists(metaphlan_file)) read_metaphlan(metaphlan_file) else NULL

# ---- SingleM ----
singlem_file <- ra("singlem", "singlem.tsv")
singlem <- if (file.exists(singlem_file)) read_table_quiet(singlem_file) else NULL
fraction_file <- ra("singlem", "microbial_fraction.tsv")
microbial_fraction <- if (file.exists(fraction_file)) read_table_quiet(fraction_file) else NULL

# ---- sylph ----
sylph_files <- setNames(ra("sylph", paste0(libraries(), ".profiling.tsv")), libraries())
sylph_files <- sylph_files[file.exists(sylph_files)]
sylph <- map_dfr(names(sylph_files), ~ mutate(read_table_quiet(sylph_files[[.x]]), library = .x))

# ---- HUMAnN: the files per library, since the merged file repeats their headers ----
humann_files <- setNames(ra("humann", paste0(libraries(), "_genefamilies.tsv")), libraries())
humann_files <- humann_files[file.exists(humann_files)]
humann <- map_dfr(names(humann_files), function(library) {
  table <- read_tsv(humann_files[[library]], show_col_types = FALSE, col_names = c("feature", "rpk"), skip = 1)
  unstratified <- filter(table, !grepl("|", feature, fixed = TRUE))
  families <- filter(unstratified, !feature %in% c("UNMAPPED", "UNGROUPED"))
  tibble(
    library = library,
    total_rpk = sum(unstratified$rpk),
    unmapped_rpk = sum(unstratified$rpk[unstratified$feature == "UNMAPPED"]),
    gene_families = sum(families$rpk > 0),
    top = list(arrange(families, desc(rpk)) %>% head(100))
  )
})

# ---- DIAMOND ----
diamond_dbs <- names(ctx$features$databases$diamond)
diamond <- map_dfr(diamond_dbs, function(db) {
  file <- ra("diamond", db, "summary_a.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
  read_table_quiet(file) %>%
    pivot_longer(-1, names_to = "file", values_to = "hits") %>%
    rename(feature = 1) %>%
    mutate(database = db, hits = replace_na(as.numeric(hits), 0))
})

phyloflash_html <- ra("phyloflash", paste0(gsub(".", "_", libraries(), fixed = TRUE), ".phyloFlash.html"))
phyloflash_html <- phyloflash_html[file.exists(phyloflash_html)]
```

```{r brief}
section("Results in brief", {
  para("This module describes the community from the clean reads, without an assembly. Each tool answers another question, and ",
       "their databases differ, so their numbers don't have to agree.")
  brief <- c(
    if (nrow(kraken_summary) > 0) {
      paste0("**Kraken2** classified between ", fmt_pct(min(kraken_summary$classified_pct)), " and ", fmt_pct(max(kraken_summary$classified_pct)),
             " of the read pairs, with the database", if (length(kraken_dbs) > 1) "s " else " ", paste0("`", unique(kraken_summary$database), "`", collapse = ", "), ".")
    },
    if (nrow(nonpareil) > 0) {
      paste0("**Nonpareil** estimates a sequencing coverage of ", fmt_pct(100 * min(nonpareil$C, na.rm = TRUE), 0), " to ", fmt_pct(100 * max(nonpareil$C, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
             " of the community per library.")
    },
    if (!is.null(ncyc)) paste0("**NCycDB** found ", nrow(ncyc$table), " nitrogen-cycle genes, after a random sample of ", fmt_int(ncyc$sampling), " reads per file."),
    if (!is.null(metaphlan)) paste0("**MetaPhlAn** detected ", sum(grepl("s__", metaphlan$clade) & !grepl("t__", metaphlan$clade)), " species."),
    if (!is.null(singlem)) paste0("**SingleM** profiled ", n_distinct(singlem$sample), " libraries."),
    if (nrow(sylph) > 0) paste0("**sylph** detected ", n_distinct(sylph$Genome_file), " reference genomes."),
    if (nrow(humann) > 0) paste0("**HUMAnN** left a mean of ", fmt_pct(100 * mean(humann$unmapped_rpk / humann$total_rpk)), " of the abundance unmapped.")
  )
  if (length(brief) > 0) bullets(brief) else para("No output of a read-based tool was found yet.")
})
```

```{r kraken2}
section("Taxonomic classification with Kraken2", {
  if (nrow(kraken) == 0) {
    no_output("Kraken2", "results/read_annotate/kraken2/")
  } else {
    para("Kraken2 assigns each read pair to a taxon by its k-mers. The share of classified reads depends strongly on the database: a low share ",
         "often means that the database lacks the community, not that the reads are bad. These numbers count reads, so large genomes count more ",
         "than small genomes.")
    show_table(
      kraken_summary %>% transmute(
        Database = database, Library = library, `Read pairs` = fmt_int(total), Classified = fmt_pct(classified_pct),
        Genera = fmt_int(genera), Species = fmt_int(species), `Shannon (species)` = fmt_num(shannon_species, 2)
      ),
      "Kraken2 per library and database",
      "kraken2_summary",
      export = kraken_summary,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    for (db in unique(kraken$database)) {
      subset <- filter(kraken, database == db)
      for (level in list(c("P", "phylum"), c("G", "genus"), c("S", "species"))) {
        wide <- subset %>%
          filter(rank == level[[1]]) %>%
          select(name, taxid, library, clade) %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = library, values_from = clade, values_fill = 0)
        write_tsv(wide, file.path(ctx$tables, paste0("kraken2_", db, "_", level[[2]], "_reads.tsv")))
      }
      for (level in list(c("P", "phylum", "Phylum"), c("G", "genus", "Genus"))) {
        table <- filter(subset, rank == level[[1]], clade > 0)
        if (nrow(table) == 0) next
        table <- table %>%
          group_by(library) %>%
          mutate(share = 100 * clade / sum(clade)) %>%
          ungroup() %>%
          mutate(taxon = top_n_other(name, share, n = 10)) %>%
          group_by(library, taxon) %>%
          summarise(share = sum(share), .groups = "drop")
        show_figure(
          composition_plot(table),
          paste0("kraken2_", db, "_", level[[2]]),
          paste0(level[[3]], " composition from Kraken2 with the database ", db, ", as a share of the reads classified at this rank."),
          height = rows_height(n_distinct(table$library), 0.17, 2)
        )
      }
    }
    krona <- Sys.glob(ra("krona", "*", "*.html"))
    if (length(krona) > 0) {
      para("Interactive Krona charts of all ", length(krona), " reports are in `results/read_annotate/krona/`.")
    }
  }
})
```

```{r nonpareil}
section("Sequencing coverage with Nonpareil", {
  if (nrow(nonpareil) == 0) {
    no_output("Nonpareil", "results/read_annotate/nonpareil/nonpareil.tsv")
  } else {
    para(
      "Nonpareil estimates how much of the community the reads have covered, from how often reads overlap. **Coverage** is that estimate (C in Nonpareil), ",
      "and **Effort** the sequencing effort behind it (LR). **Effort for 95%** is what would reach 95% coverage (LR*), and **Diversity** is Nonpareil's sequence diversity ",
      "index. If coverage is low, many rare genomes can't be assembled, and more sequencing would help. If a curve has no model, shown here as `-`, the effort for 95% can't ",
      "be estimated: this is common at a low coverage."
    )
    show_table(
      nonpareil %>% transmute(
        Library = sample_id, Coverage = fmt_pct(100 * C), Effort = fmt_bp(LR), `Effort for 95%` = fmt_bp(LRstar), `Model fit (R)` = fmt_num(modelR, 3),
        Diversity = ifelse(is.na(LRstar), "-", fmt_num(diversity, 2)), `More sequencing for 95%` = ifelse(is.na(LRstar), "-", paste0(fmt_num(LRstar / LR), " times"))
      ),
      "Nonpareil coverage, sequencing effort and diversity",
      "nonpareil",
      export = nonpareil,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    curves <- map_dfr(libraries(), function(library) {
      file <- ra("nonpareil", paste0(library, ".npo"))
      if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
      table <- read.table(file, comment.char = "#", col.names = c("effort", "coverage", "sd", "q1", "q2", "q3"))
      filter(mutate(table, library = library), effort > 0)
    })
    if (nrow(curves) > 0) {
      write_tsv(curves, file.path(ctx$tables, "nonpareil_curves.tsv"))
      show_figure(
        ggplot(curves, aes(effort, coverage, group = library, colour = library)) +
          geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
          scale_x_log10() +
          scale_colour_manual(values = rep_len(PALETTE, n_distinct(curves$library)), guide = if (n_libraries > 12) "none" else guide_legend(ncol = 3), name = NULL) +
          labs(x = "Sequencing effort (reads, logarithmic scale)", y = "Estimated coverage") +
          theme_report(),
        "nonpareil_curves",
        "Nonpareil curves: estimated coverage at growing sequencing effort, one line per library."
      )
    }
  }
})
```

```{r singlem}
section("Marker-gene profile with SingleM", {
  if (is.null(singlem)) {
    no_output("SingleM", "results/read_annotate/singlem/singlem.tsv")
  } else {
    para("SingleM counts conserved marker genes in the reads, so its profile doesn't depend on a complete genome in a database, and it gives ",
         "coverage per genome and not a read count.")
    write_tsv(singlem, file.path(ctx$tables, "singlem_profile.tsv"))
    phyla <- singlem %>%
      mutate(levels = lengths(strsplit(taxonomy, ";"))) %>%
      filter(levels == 3) %>%
      mutate(phylum = sub("^.*; *", "", taxonomy), library = sub("\\.lib.*$", "", sample)) %>%
      group_by(sample) %>%
      mutate(share = 100 * coverage / sum(coverage)) %>%
      ungroup()
    if (nrow(phyla) > 0) {
      phyla <- phyla %>%
        transmute(library = sample, taxon = top_n_other(phylum, share, n = 10), share) %>%
        group_by(library, taxon) %>%
        summarise(share = sum(share), .groups = "drop")
      show_figure(
        composition_plot(phyla),
        "singlem_phylum",
        "Phylum composition from SingleM, as a share of the coverage assigned to a phylum in the condensed profile.",
        height = rows_height(n_distinct(phyla$library), 0.17, 2)
      )
    }
    if (!is.null(microbial_fraction)) {
      para("The microbial fraction estimates how much of the reads comes from bacteria and archaea. A low value points to host, plant or other ",
           "eukaryotic DNA, and to the need for a deeper look at the host removal.")
      show_table(microbial_fraction, "Microbial fraction of each library", "singlem_microbial_fraction", max_rows = 60)
    }
  }
})
```

```{r sylph}
section("Genome-based profile with sylph", {
  if (nrow(sylph) == 0) {
    no_output("sylph", "results/read_annotate/sylph/")
  } else {
    para("sylph looks for k-mers of reference genomes in the reads. **Sequence abundance** is the share of reads, and **taxonomic abundance** the share of ",
         "genome copies. The sum of sequence abundance shows how much of the reads the database explains.")
    per_library <- sylph %>%
      group_by(library) %>%
      summarise(genomes = n(), explained_pct = sum(Sequence_abundance), median_ani = median(Adjusted_ANI), .groups = "drop")
    show_table(
      per_library %>% transmute(Library = library, Genomes = fmt_int(genomes), `Reads explained` = fmt_pct(explained_pct), `Median ANI` = fmt_num(median_ani, 1)),
      "sylph per library",
      "sylph_per_library",
      export = per_library,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    top <- sylph %>%
      group_by(genome = basename(Genome_file), name = Contig_name) %>%
      summarise(libraries = n(), mean_abundance = sum(Taxonomic_abundance) / n_libraries, .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(mean_abundance))
    show_table(
      top %>% transmute(Genome = genome, Name = substr(name, 1, 45), Libraries = libraries, `Mean abundance` = fmt_pct(mean_abundance, 2)),
      "The most abundant genomes in sylph, by mean taxonomic abundance",
      "sylph_top_genomes",
      export = top,
      max_rows = 20
    )
  }
})
```

```{r metaphlan}
section("Taxonomic profile with MetaPhlAn", {
  if (is.null(metaphlan)) {
    no_output("MetaPhlAn", "results/read_annotate/metaphlan/metaphlan_profiled.tsv")
  } else {
    para("MetaPhlAn estimates the relative abundance of species from clade-specific marker genes. It can only report what its database contains, ",
         "and that is less for rumen or soil than for human samples.")
    species <- metaphlan %>%
      filter(grepl("s__", clade), !grepl("t__", clade)) %>%
      mutate(species = sub("^.*s__", "", clade)) %>%
      select(-clade) %>%
      select(species, everything())
    long <- pivot_longer(species, -species, names_to = "library", values_to = "abundance")
    write_tsv(species, file.path(ctx$tables, "metaphlan_species.tsv"))
    diversity <- long %>%
      group_by(library) %>%
      summarise(species = sum(abundance > 0), shannon = shannon(abundance), .groups = "drop")
    show_table(
      diversity %>% transmute(Library = library, Species = fmt_int(species), Shannon = fmt_num(shannon, 2)),
      "Species detected and Shannon diversity per library, from MetaPhlAn",
      "metaphlan_diversity",
      export = diversity,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    top <- long %>% group_by(species) %>% summarise(mean = mean(abundance), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(desc(mean)) %>% head(25)
    if (nrow(top) > 0) {
      show_figure(
        long %>%
          filter(species %in% top$species) %>%
          mutate(species = factor(species, levels = top$species), value = log10(abundance + 0.01)) %>%
          arrange(species) %>%
          mutate(species = as.character(species)) %>%
          heatmap_plot(y = "species", legend = "log10(% + 0.01)"),
        "metaphlan_heatmap",
        "The 25 species with the highest mean abundance in MetaPhlAn.",
        height = 5.5
      )
    }
  }
})
```

```{r humann}
section("Functional profile with HUMAnN", {
  if (nrow(humann) == 0) {
    no_output("HUMAnN", "results/read_annotate/humann/")
  } else {
    para("HUMAnN maps reads to pangenomes of the species that MetaPhlAn found, and then to a protein database. A high share of unmapped abundance is ",
         "common in communities with many unknown genomes. Abundance is in RPK, reads per kilobase of gene.")
    summary <- humann %>% transmute(library, gene_families, total_rpk, unmapped_rpk, unmapped_pct = 100 * unmapped_rpk / total_rpk)
    show_table(
      summary %>% transmute(Library = library, `Gene families` = fmt_int(gene_families), `Total RPK` = fmt_int(total_rpk), Unmapped = fmt_pct(unmapped_pct)),
      "HUMAnN per library",
      "humann_per_library",
      export = summary,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    top <- humann %>%
      select(library, top) %>%
      unnest(top) %>%
      group_by(feature) %>%
      summarise(mean_rpk = sum(rpk) / nrow(humann), libraries = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(mean_rpk))
    show_table(
      top %>% transmute(`Gene family` = feature, `Mean RPK` = fmt_int(mean_rpk), Libraries = libraries),
      "The most abundant gene families, among the top 100 of each library",
      "humann_top_families",
      export = top,
      max_rows = 15
    )
  }
})
```

```{r diamond}
section("Protein-level annotation with DIAMOND", {
  if (nrow(diamond) == 0) {
    no_output("DIAMOND", "results/read_annotate/diamond/")
  } else {
    for (db in unique(diamond$database)) {
      subset <- filter(diamond, database == db)

        max_rows = 40

      top <- subset %>%
        group_by(feature) %>%
        summarise(total = sum(hits), .groups = "drop") %>%
        arrange(desc(total))
      show_table(
        top %>% transmute(Feature = feature, `All hits` = fmt_int(total)),
        paste0("The most frequent features, database ", db),
        paste0("diamond_", db, "_top_features"),
        export = top,
        max_rows = 15
      )
    }
```

```{r ncyc}
section("Nitrogen-cycle genes with NCycDB", {
  if (is.null(ncyc)) {
    no_output("NCycProfiler", "results/read_annotate/ncyc/ncyc_results.tsv")
  } else {
    para("NCycProfiler searches a random sample of ", fmt_int(ncyc$sampling), " reads of each file against NCycDB, which makes the files comparable. ",
         "The table adds the two read files of each library.")
    long <- ncyc$table %>%
      pivot_longer(-Gene, names_to = "file", values_to = "hits") %>%
      mutate(library = sub("_[12]$", "", file)) %>%
      group_by(Gene, library) %>%
      summarise(hits = sum(hits), .groups = "drop")
    wide <- pivot_wider(long, names_from = library, values_from = hits)
    write_tsv(wide, file.path(ctx$tables, "ncyc_hits_per_library.tsv"))
    per_library <- long %>%
      group_by(library) %>%
      summarise(genes = sum(hits > 0), hits = sum(hits), .groups = "drop")
    show_table(
      per_library %>% transmute(Library = library, Hits = fmt_int(hits), `Genes found` = fmt_int(genes)),
      "Nitrogen-cycle genes per library",
      "ncyc_per_library",
      export = per_library,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    top <- long %>% group_by(Gene) %>% summarise(total = sum(hits), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(desc(total)) %>% head(25)
    show_figure(
      long %>%
        filter(Gene %in% top$Gene) %>%
        mutate(rank = match(Gene, top$Gene), value = log10(hits + 1)) %>%
        arrange(rank) %>%
        heatmap_plot(y = "Gene", legend = "log10(hits + 1)"),
      "ncyc_heatmap",
      "The most frequent nitrogen-cycle genes per library.",
      height = max(3, nrow(top) * 0.17 + 1.5)
    )
  }
})
```

```{r methods}
section("Methods text", {
  para("You can use or adapt this text for a paper. It lists the tools with output in this project. Add database versions from the reference report.")
  features <- ctx$features$databases
  sentences <- c(
    if (nrow(kraken) > 0) paste0("Reads were classified with ", tv("Kraken2"), " against ", paste0(basename(unlist(features$kraken2)), collapse = ", "), ", and visualized with ", tv("Krona"), "."),
    if (nrow(nonpareil) > 0) paste0("Sequencing coverage was estimated with ", tv("Nonpareil"), " in k-mer mode, using the forward reads (", ctx$params$read_annotate$nonpareil$X %||% "?", " query reads)."),
    if (!is.null(singlem)) paste0("A taxonomic profile and the microbial fraction were obtained with ", tv("SingleM"), " and the metapackage ", basename(features$singlem %||% "?"), "."),
    if (nrow(sylph) > 0) paste0("Genomes were profiled with ", tv("sylph"), " and ", basename(features$sylph %||% "?"), "."),
    if (!is.null(metaphlan)) paste0("Species were profiled with ", tv("MetaPhlAn"), "."),
    if (nrow(humann) > 0) paste0("Functional profiles were computed with ", tv("HUMAnN"), "."),
    if (length(phyloflash_html) > 0) paste0("SSU rRNA was analysed with ", tv("phyloFlash"), "."),
    if (nrow(diamond) > 0) paste0("Reads were searched against ", paste(names(features$diamond), collapse = ", "), " with ", tv("DIAMOND"), " (blastx, ", ctx$params$read_annotate$diamond$`max-target-seqs` %||% "?", " target per query)."),
    if (!is.null(ncyc)) paste0("Nitrogen-cycle genes were counted with NCycProfiler and NCycDB, using ", tv("DIAMOND"), ".")
  )
  if (length(sentences) > 0) para("> ", paste(sentences, collapse = " ")) else para("There is no output to describe yet.")
})
```

```{r end}
report_end(c(
  kraken2 = "Classification of each read, reports", krona = "Interactive taxonomy charts", nonpareil = "Coverage curves and summary",
  singlem = "Marker-gene tables and profile", sylph = "Genome profiles", metaphlan = "Species profiles", humann = "Gene families",
  phyloflash = "SSU rRNA reports", diamond = "Protein hits of the reads", ncyc = "Nitrogen-cycle genes"
))
```
